identity.title: Spatially Resolved HCN J = 4-3 and CS J = 7-6 Emission from the Disk around HD 142527

paper_type_evidence.quote: In this manuscript we present spatially resolved ALMA detections of the HCN J=4–3 and CS J=7–6 emission lines.

question.value: Do HCN J=4-3 and CS J=7-6 trace the HD 142527 disk, and why is their emission suppressed under the horseshoe-shaped continuum peak?

evidence.quote: Both emission lines are azimuthally asymmetric and are suppressed under the horseshoe-shaped continuum emission peak.

findings_qualitative.value: First detection of CS J=7-6 from a protoplanetary disk

evidence.quote: This is the first detection of CS J=7–6 coming from a protoplanetary disk.

findings_qualitative.value: No counterpart of CS/HCN emission to the scattered-light and CO spiral structure

evidence.quote: We see no counterpart for the CS and HCN emission with the spiral structure seen in scattered light and CO rotational lines.

claims.hypothesis: Are CS and HCN emission detected and azimuthally asymmetric?
claims.result: Both detected, strongest to the southwest, suppressed under continuum peak
claims.finding: Emission is anticorrelated with the dust trap

evidence.quote: The emission of both molecules is azimutally asymmetric, peaks towards the southwest of the disk and is suppressed in those regions with strong continuum emission.

claims.hypothesis: Is the asymmetry due to line-of-sight projection of the inner rim?
claims.experiment: Orientation argument plus MCFOST model grid
claims.result: No models gave a brighter near side of the inner edge
claims.finding: Projection of the inner rim is discarded

evidence.quote: We discard a line-of-sight projection of the inner rim of the outer disk as origin of this asymmetry.

claims.hypothesis: Does the dust trap cause the decrement?
claims.experiment: Qualitative discussion of temperature, freeze-out and continuum opacity
claims.result: Lower dust/gas temperature and optically thick continuum are plausible
claims.finding: Two possible mechanisms are suggested, not tested quantitatively

evidence.quote: We suggest two possible mechanisms that can drive this asymmetry related to the presence of a dust trap
rule out emission from the inner rim of the outer disk inclined into the line of sight as source for the brightness asymmetry

limitations_admitted.value: Dust-trap effect on gas temperature not modelled

evidence.quote: Modeling the effect of a dust trap on the local gas temperature is beyond the scope of this manuscript.

referee_caveats_inferred: Mechanisms are qualitative with no chemical modelling
